subject: Pilot: short grace window + limited burst offer
messages:
From: Adele Simmons <adele@olivefish.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Owen Park <owen@olivefish.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot ask: short grace window + limited burst during integration

Hi Connor,

Quick note from the OliveFish integration team: we’re wrapping up model wiring this week but anticipate a couple of interrupting factors (3rd‑party connector delay + data mapping fixes) that will leave us a few days shy of the original pilot end date. Could Redwood accommodate a short grace window (7–10 days) to avoid a hard stop while we finish the integration?

Additionally, we expect two short periods where our traffic will spike ~2x for a few hours while running scale tests. We don’t want to upgrade the whole pilot, but we do need a small burst capacity for those windows.

Can you outline what options you can provide (pricing and protection against overage surprises)? We’re trying to avoid re‑negotiating formal terms if possible — a simple addendum or one‑page agreement would work.

Thanks,
Adele
Adele Simmons
Head of Integrations, OliveFish Labs
adele@olivefish.ai
(415) 555‑0147


From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Adele Simmons <adele@olivefish.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask: short grace window + limited burst during integration

Hi Adele — appreciate the heads up. We can absolutely avoid a hard stop and keep things simple. Two practical paths we typically offer for situations like this:

Option A — Grace Window + Surge Pocket (recommended for short fixes)
- A 10‑day grace window immediately following the current pilot end date (no change to baseline SLOs).
- A one‑time surge pocket: 50,000 token burst bucket reserved for OliveFish behaviorally allocated to your pilot. Unused tokens expire at the end of the grace window.
- Billing: surge pocket purchased upfront at $180 (equivalent to $0.0036/token) and any usage beyond the pocket billed at standard overage rates.
- No changes to the main pilot commitment; addendum is a one‑page note.

Option B — Convert unused days to a Burst Voucher (recommended if you have leftover commitment)
- If you have remaining committed capacity from the pilot, we can convert the equivalent value into a time‑limited burst voucher that sits on the account and is drawn first during spikes.
- Voucher discount: 12% off list for this conversion. Voucher valid for 30 days from issue.
- This avoids any additional cash outlay today but requires we apply the conversion to the existing pilot invoice.

Additional notes:
- Both options include a hard cap setting so you don’t receive unexpected charges; we’ll notify you at 80% of the pocket/voucher usage and automatically block further token consumption unless you explicitly authorize it.
- If OliveFish signs a 3‑month post‑pilot conversion within 21 days of the pilot close, we’ll apply a 10% credit to the first month as a conversion incentive.

I’ve attached a short addendum PDF that covers Option A language and the voucher mechanics for Option B: OF_eval_grace_window_proposal.pdf — Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1OFproposal

If you want to proceed with Option A, reply with “Approve Option A” and I’ll execute the addendum and provision the pocket immediately. If you’re leaning to Option B, tell me the remaining committed token volume and I’ll run the conversion math.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai | (650) 555‑0291

2) Are latency SLOs (p95) the same during the grace window / bursts or do we see a temporary change in targets when the pocket is consumed?

Adele — cc'ing so you see the options.

Owen — good questions. Quick answers and one operational detail: 

1) Scope of the pocket: we scope the surge pocket to the pilot API key(s) you nominate. If you want it shared across both inference and embedding keys, we can allocate the pocket at the project level and set routing rules so the burst is consumed from the same bucket regardless of endpoint. Just tell us which keys to include in the addendum.

2) Latency SLOs: baseline p95 targets remain the same during the grace window. The pocket is strictly a capacity buffer; if you push sustained load beyond what the pilot hardware supports we’ll surface a performance advisory but won’t change the p95 SLO in the agreement. Short bursts (the kind the pocket is designed for) should see no change.

Operational point: I can push Option A today and provision the pocket immediately (we’ll charge the $180 fee and set notifications at 80% usage). If OliveFish prefers Option B, Vanessa can run the conversion math against any unused committed tokens and we’ll issue the voucher.

Adele — if you’re good with Option A, reply with “Approve Option A (10‑day grace + 50k pocket)” and I’ll attach the signed addendum and provision.

Thanks — Connor
